name: effect
readmeExcerpt:
# Effect

Effect is a library for building robust, maintainable, type-safe, and production grade applications in TypeScript. It helps you handle the hard problems at scale: typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and unified schema validation.

> **Effect 4.x is a long-term support (LTS) release.** If you are upgrading from Effect 3.x, follow the [migration guide](MIGRATION.md).

## Installation

```sh
npm install effect
```

## Requirements

- **TypeScript 5.9 or newer.** TypeScript 7 is recommended for the best performance and compatibility with [Effect's TypeScript tooling](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo#installation).
- **Node.js 18 or newer** is the general minimum for running Effect on Node.js. Some integration packages require newer runtimes; for example, `@effect/sql-sqlite-node` requires Node.js 22.16 or newer.
- **Strict type-checking:** the `strict` flag must be enabled in your `tsconfig.json`.

## Links

- [Website](https://effect.website): documentation, guides, and news
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/effect-ts): ask questions, share what you're building, and talk to the core team
- [Community](https://effect.website/community-hub): meetups and events, or bring Effect to your own
- [Issues](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/issues): bug reports and feature requests
- [Jobs](https://effect.website/effect-jobs): companies hiring Effect developers
- Follow us on [X](https://x.com/EffectTS_), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/effect-ts.bsky.social), and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/effect-ts)

## Let's talk

Whether your team is considering Effect, rolling it out, or already running it in production, we'd love to hear from you: what you're building, what works, and what you need from Effect next.

- **Talk to the maintainers.** Introduce your team on [Discord](https://discord.gg/effect-ts) or email [contact@effectful.co](mailto:contact@effectful.co). We're happy to connect privately on Slack or Discord for feedback and help with adoption.
- **Production support.** We're exploring how to better support teams running Effect in production. If your organization has specific support needs, let's discuss them.
- **Adoption help.** Our [adoption partners](https://effect.website/adoption-partners) offer implementation, consulting, team extension, training, and commercial support.

Feedback from teams using and evaluating Effect directly shapes what we stabilize and build next.

## Long-term support

Teams depend on Effect for systems they expect to run for years. Effect 4.x is a long-term support (LTS) release with the following guarantees:

- At least three years of support, including bug and security fixes.
- Bug fixes for one year after the next major version is released.
- Security fixes for two years after the next major version is released.

Stable APIs reserve breaking changes for major releases. APIs marked unstable may change in minor releases, and experimental APIs may change in patch releases.

## Effect v3

The Effect v3 source code is available on the [`v3`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/tree/v3) branch, which is also where issues and pull requests meant for Effect v3 should be targeted. To upgrade, see the [migration guide](MIGRATION.md).

releases.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#9030](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/9030) [`7547a99`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/7547a99f81fa6f7e651d52f3d42081f399bfbca8) Thanks @effect-bot! - Bound sparse array indices in `SchemaGetter.makeTreeRecord`, used by `Schema.fromURLSearchParams` and `Schema.fromFormData`. An indexed container with more than 20 holes is now returned as an object keyed by its index strings instead of a sparse array, and appending after the maximum array index no longer throws.

- [#9083](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/9083) [`711719d`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/711719d28d78dddda4d1685b916d1edf1eae9e98) Thanks @effect-bot! - Bound import-time stack detection probes to the frames they inspect, restoring the caller's stack trace limit afterward.

- [#9041](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/9041) [`8f1ea52`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/8f1ea52f0c073daf445adb987d23860dd76a147c) Thanks @tim-smart! - Stop grouped RequestResolvers from retaining batch keys for the lifetime of the resolver. Equal keys are now matched by the pending batch map, so a key is dropped as soon as its batch stops pending, including after i

aiSummary.oneLiner: Comprehensive TypeScript library for building robust, type-safe applications with structured concurrency and typed errors.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Effect is a powerful, functional programming library designed to bring production-grade robustness to TypeScript applications. It tackles the most difficult problems in software engineering at scale by providing a unified ecosystem for handling typed errors, asynchronous operations, and dependency injection. Unlike standard Promises, Effect uses a highly optimized runtime that supports structured concurrency, advanced scheduling, and automatic resource management. It also includes built-in capabilities for distributed tracing and schema validation. By enforcing strict type safety across all operations, it eliminates entire classes of runtime errors and makes complex logic highly maintainable.
keyFeatures: Typed error handling: Tracks all possible errors in the type signature, forcing developers to handle edge cases explicitly.
Structured concurrency: Provides advanced primitives for running operations in parallel, racing them, and managing cancellations.
Dependency injection: Manages application context and dependencies entirely within the type system without decorators.
Built-in observability: Includes native support for distributed tracing, logging, and metrics without external wrappers.
Unified schema validation: Integrates data parsing and validation directly into the functional pipelines.

useCases.title: Build resilient backend services
useCases.description: Construct high-throughput Node.js APIs that handle complex asynchronous workflows and database transactions reliably.

useCases.title: Manage complex state machines
useCases.description: Use functional pipelines to deterministically manage application state and complex retry logic.

useCases.title: Implement robust error recovery
useCases.description: Leverage typed errors to guarantee that network failures and data parsing issues are caught and handled.

useCases.title: Create concurrent data pipelines
useCases.description: Safely execute massive parallel data processing tasks using structured concurrency and fiber primitives.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Effect is built for senior TypeScript developers and engineering teams constructing large-scale, mission-critical applications. It requires a solid understanding of functional programming concepts and advanced TypeScript type-level programming.
